Class PlanetGeneratorDataAndValidationHelper

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.planetgen.PlanetGeneratorDataAndValidationHelper
public final class PlanetGeneratorDataAndValidationHelper extends Object
Data marshaling, geospatial raster export/import, WMS climate fetching, and setup validation helper for PlanetGeneratorPanel.

Extracted in accordance with the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP) to decouple PlanetPreset assembly, JSON persistence callbacks, celestial body raster loading, radiative forcing thermal bounds, and validation styling from the UI container.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.3
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • bindPresetBarListener

      public static void bindPresetBarListener(PresetControlBar<PlanetPreset> topPresetBar, BooleanSupplier isUpdatingSupplier, BooleanSupplier validateSupplier, Supplier<PlanetPreset> buildPresetSupplier, Consumer<PlanetPreset> applyPresetAction, Runnable resetPreviewMode)
      Configures the PresetControlBar.PresetActionsListener handling selection, save, delete, JSON export, and JSON import operations for planetary presets.
      Parameters:
      topPresetBar - the preset control bar to bind
      isUpdatingSupplier - supplies whether the host panel is currently applying a preset
      validateSupplier - validates current UI state prior to saving
      buildPresetSupplier - constructs a PlanetPreset snapshot from active UI controls
      applyPresetAction - applies a selected or imported PlanetPreset
      resetPreviewMode - callback resetting preview mode index on preset selection

    • buildPresetFromUI

      public static PlanetPreset buildPresetFromUI(javafx.scene.control.ComboBox<PlanetPreset> presetCombo, javafx.scene.control.ComboBox<Integer> resolutionCombo, PlanetAstroSectionBuilder astro, PlanetTopographySectionBuilder topo, PlanetClimateSectionBuilder climate, javafx.scene.image.Image customBiomeImage, String cachedBiomeB64, Consumer<String> setCachedBiomeB64, javafx.scene.image.Image customResourceImage, String cachedResourceB64, Consumer<String> setCachedResourceB64)
      Assembles an immutable PlanetPreset record from all active astronomical, topographic, climatic, and custom base64 raster states in the UI.
      Parameters:
      presetCombo - active preset selector combo box
      resolutionCombo - H3 resolution selector combo box
      astro - astronomical section builder
      topo - topography section builder
      climate - climate section builder
      customBiomeImage - optional custom biome raster image
      cachedBiomeB64 - cached Base64 PNG encoding for biome image (nullable)
      setCachedBiomeB64 - callback storing newly encoded biome Base64 PNG
      customResourceImage - optional custom resource raster image
      cachedResourceB64 - cached Base64 PNG encoding for resource image (nullable)
      setCachedResourceB64 - callback storing newly encoded resource Base64 PNG
      Returns:
      assembled PlanetPreset
